description: This file defines quantized linear modules for PyTorch, including classes for packed parameters and a quantized linear layer with serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: LinearPackedParams
classes.description: Handles packed parameters for quantized linear layers, supporting different data types and serialization.

classes.name: Linear
classes.description: A quantized linear module compatible with PyTorch's nn.Linear, supporting serialization, deserialization, and conversion from float modules.

methods.name: set_weight_bias
methods.description: Sets the weight and bias for the packed parameters, supporting different data types.

methods.name: _weight_bias
methods.description: Retrieves the unpacked weight and bias from the packed parameters.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the linear operation using quantized weights and inputs.

methods.name: _save_to_state_dict
methods.description: Serializes the module's state, including dtype and packed parameters.

methods.name: _load_from_state_dict
methods.description: Deserializes the module's state, supporting different versions.

methods.name: extra_repr
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the module's configuration.

methods.name: set_weight_bias
methods.description: Sets the weight and bias tensors.

methods.name: from_float
methods.description: Creates a quantized module from a float module, with optional precomputed fake quantization.

methods.name: from_reference
methods.description: Creates a quantized module from a reference quantized module, with specified output scale and zero point.
